mission: DSE MICROSTRUCTURE ADVANTAGE - fused order-book + order-flow + market-context engine, prospective validation
primary_question: Does fused order-book + order-flow + market-context information predict the next market move better than the STRONGEST standalone book/flow baseline, repeatedly, on unseen live sessions?
frozen_before: any frame of any NEW (post-2026-09-06) live session was read

calibration_evidence_only.status: ALREADY SEEN. Used for engineering/calibration and pipeline smoke-test ONLY. NEVER counted as DEV, VALIDATION or HOLDOUT. Never used as prospective validation.
calibration_evidence_only.what_it_informed: column availability, frame cadence (median 43.7 s), quality-gate rates, sane hyperparameter defaults. No outcome-driven tuning.

repository.policy: READ-ONLY. No commits, no pushes. Repo code untouched.

universe_source: the exact 14 symbols of the existing live experiment (results/seeing/2026-09-06/DENOMINATOR.json). Held FIXED for the whole prospective test; not re-selected per session.

BOOK.resilience: ask_replenished_after_depletion minus bid analogue, and resilience_frames

FLOW.signed_flow_w: rolling sum of signed_int_volume over W_FLOW frames, normalised by rolling volume
FLOW.ofi_w: rolling sum of (ev_bid_add_qty - ev_bid_reduce_qty) - (ev_ask_add_qty - ev_ask_reduce_qty) over W_FLOW, normalised by liquidity_top5
FLOW.trade_acceleration: trade_intensity minus its W_FLOW-frame rolling mean

CONTEXT.mkt_pressure: cross-sectional mean of one_frame_pressure over the universe at the nearest timestamp
CONTEXT.xs_pressure_rank: within-timestamp percentile rank of this symbol's one_frame_pressure across the universe

frozen_features.no_future_field_rule: every feature is computed from information at or before frame t. No fwd_* column, no forward timestamp, no session-level aggregate that spans t may enter the feature matrix.

degrade_not_exclude: book_agree missing or book_diff large (second sensor unavailable or disagreeing)
quality_gates_input_only.rule: quality flags are INPUT GATES. They are never used as predictors and never appear in the feature matrix.

outcomes.reuse: the existing seeing/tower semantics: forward MID move measured in ticks. Not silently redefined.
outcomes.definition: fwd_mid_ticks_H = (mid[t_fwd] - mid[t]) / tick_size, where t_fwd is the FIRST frame of the SAME symbol in the SAME session with t_fwd >= t + H seconds
outcomes.valid_H: t_fwd exists in-session AND (t_fwd - t) <= 2*H seconds (no stretching across a capture gap) AND mid present at both ends
outcomes.horizon_note: the mission specifies horizons in SECONDS; median frame cadence is 43.7 s, so horizons are anchored by timestamp, not by a fixed frame count. The up/down semantics are unchanged from the repo.

model_family.target: 3-class {DOWN, FLAT, UP} at the primary horizon, giving p_down / p_flat / p_up directly

M1.standardise: z-score, mean/std fit on DEV ONLY

forbidden: hyperparameter search beyond the two frozen configurations above

baselines_to_beat.B8_book_pressure: existing book pressure = one_frame_pressure smoothed over W_FLOW frames
baselines_to_beat.B9_trade_pressure: rolling signed flow over W_FLOW frames normalised by rolling volume
baselines_to_beat.B10_combined_rule: existing rule-based composite: sign(imb_top5) when |imb_top5| > theta_imb(0.20) and persistent_bid_pressure or its mirror, else 0
baselines_to_beat.scoring: each baseline is a directional SCORE (positive = up). All baselines and the fused model are scored with the IDENTICAL metric on the IDENTICAL eligible rows.
baselines_to_beat.pass_rule: the fused engine must beat the STRONGEST baseline, not the average.

primary_metric.metric: AUC-ROC for discriminating UP vs DOWN at the primary horizon (FLAT rows excluded from AUC), on eligible rows
primary_metric.incremental: AUC(fused) - AUC(best baseline on the same rows)
secondary: episode-level directional hit rate at the locked confidence threshold
lift = p_up(signal) - p_up(base) at the locked threshold
primary_metric.inference: block bootstrap, block = one whole SESSION, 2000 replicates, seed 7, 95% CI on the incremental AUC

episodes.definition: an episode begins at the first frame where the locked model emits a non-NEUTRAL direction for a symbol while no episode of the same direction is active for that symbol
episodes.anchor: the episode's FIRST frame supplies the single outcome; later frames of the same episode are not counted again
episodes.purpose: independence - repeated same-direction pressure on one symbol collapses into one episode

session_acceptance.rule: a session failing ANY criterion is REJECTED and does not consume a DEV/VAL/HOLDOUT slot; the rejection and its reason are recorded.

splits_whole_sessions_only.FINAL_HOLDOUT: all subsequent ACCEPTED untouched sessions until BOTH >= 100 independent pressure episodes AND >= 5 accepted holdout sessions
splits_whole_sessions_only.holdout_seal: FINAL_HOLDOUT outcomes MUST NOT be read until the denominator is complete

selection.DEV: fit M1 and M2. No claims.
selection.VALIDATION: select exactly ONE fused model and ONE confidence threshold, by best 180 s incremental AUC against the strongest baseline. Threshold grid is frozen: [0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.25] on |p_up - p_down|.
selection.then: write /tmp/dse_micro_advantage/FINAL_MODEL_LOCK.json and SHA256 it. No further fitting or tuning.

final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.A: denominator satisfied (>= 100 independent episodes AND >= 5 accepted holdout sessions)
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.B: fused 180 s directional effect has the correct sign
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.C: fused model beats EACH of B1-B10 on the same eligible holdout rows
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.D: block-bootstrap 95% CI for incremental AUC vs the BEST baseline excludes zero
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.E: effect in the same direction in >= 75% of holdout sessions
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.F: no single symbol contributes > 25% of total incremental success
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.G: 60 s and 600 s show no strong opposite-sign effect
final_holdout_pass_requires_ALL.H: mirror test behaves correctly (mirrored signal predicts DOWN)

execution_assumptions.signal_available: only AFTER frame t is fully received
execution_assumptions.earliest_action: the next FRESH observable quote (next frame with a new body_sha256) for that symbol
execution_assumptions.latency: measured capture latency (elapsed_ms) is added; no zero-latency fills
execution_assumptions.spread: crossing the spread is charged at entry and exit
execution_assumptions.brokerage: 0.008 round trip (repo config BROKERAGE_ROUND_TRIP_VERIFIED); capital-gains tax UNKNOWN, modelled 0; slippage beyond spread UNKNOWN, not modelled - so every net figure is OPTIMISTIC
execution_assumptions.not_executable: frames where locked, crossed, at circuit limit, one_sided, or the next fresh quote never arrives

classification.MARKET_READING_EDGE: fused pressure beats the strongest baseline on the sealed holdout under all of A-J
classification.TRADEABLE_ADVANTAGE: MARKET_READING_EDGE and realistic execution simulation remains positive
classification.INFORMATION_ADVANTAGE_ONLY: prediction survives but execution does not
classification.NO_INCREMENTAL_EDGE_OVER_BEST_BASELINE: fused engine fails to beat the strongest baseline
